title: ORCHID: Open Repository for CALPHAD Hypotheses, Intelligence, and Discovery
description: Curated, versioned release of openly licensed CALPHAD thermodynamic databases, binary convex hulls (Materials Project, OQMD, SGTE) and evaluated phase-equilibrium data, with licence, source and evidence class for every value. Website: https://orchid-project.org
notes: This work was supported by the U.S. National Science Foundation under award OAC-2608825 (CSSI Elements: PhaseForge).
